# Miami Metro LLC

> Miami Metro LLC is headquartered in Miami, Florida. It builds AI-native marketing systems and operates 305Electricians, a referral service. Website: https://miamimetro.us/

Miami Metro LLC and 305Electricians do not perform electrical work. This site does not publish a street address, a founding year, or customer reviews.

## Businesses

- [305Electricians](https://305electricians.com/): Referral service operated by Miami Metro LLC. It connects Miami-Dade customers with independent licensed electricians and does not do the electrical work. Phone: (305) 699-4194. Customers can use English or Spanish. Electrician signup: https://305electricians.com/pros/
- [LeadCove](https://leadcove.io/): AI prospecting platform for real estate agents, built by Miami Metro LLC.
